about_the_game:
1. In terms of type, this game is a text-based game, a galgame.
2. In terms of content, players take on the role of the game's protagonist Zhang Yuebai from childhood, experiencing a new life through the text as they follow the character. Depending on the player's choices, they will go through different stories, meet different people, and start different lives, such as the heroine Leng Wanying. The main content of the story revolves around daily life and school life, for example helping the heroine overcome low points. Most of the content is conveyed through the charm of text and illustrations, experiencing everyday yet extraordinary stories together with the heroines in the story.
3. In terms of gameplay, we value the changes brought by choices, especially in the early stages, so we hope players take their choices seriously. We hope players can treat the protagonist as themselves, and themselves as the protagonist, to experience a new life.
4. This is the free applicable version of the game. Out of passion, I abandoned my original physics major after graduating from university in 2025 to engage in game development. Although there are challenges such as lack of experience and insufficient funds, we will not give up easily.

short_description: 此为游戏免费的适用版，本人基于热爱在2025大学毕业后放弃原物理学专业从事游戏制作，虽然有经验缺乏资金不足等问题。但是我们不会轻言放弃。 本游戏为文字游戏，galgame。 玩家们扮演游戏主角从童年时期开始，通过选择遇见不同的人，开启不同的人生。我们重视选项所带的变化，特别是前期的，所以希望玩家能谨慎对待选择。我们希望玩家能够在这款游戏里把主角当作自己，把自己当作主角。经历一段新的人生。
